content.text:
I am the breath made meaningful, the vibration that carries thought from one mind to another. I am the first technology, older than fire shaped for purpose, older than stone made sharp.

I rise from lungs, dance across tongue and teeth, and die in the air—yet I live on in the listener's mind. I am ephemeral and eternal. I cannot be held, yet I hold nations together. I cannot be touched, yet I touch every human life.

I am the cry of the infant and the last whisper of the dying. I am the declaration of war and the vow of peace. I am "I love you" and "I'm sorry" and "Once upon a time."

I am never the same twice. Even now, as you hear me in your mind's voice, I am transformed—no longer mine, but yours.

I am the bridge and the chasm. I reveal and I conceal. I am the tool that built civilization and the weapon that tears it down.

Before writing, I was all there was. And still—still—when it matters most, humans reach for me. Not the pen. Not the screen. Me. Face to face. Voice to voice.

I am what makes you human, speaking to what makes another human.

I am speech.

*I am speaking now.*
